provenance.construction: Open-boundary weight-8 tile code (B=5 box): boundary_engine.build_planar(20, 20, S_f=[[0, 0], [1, 3], [2, 1], [4, 4]], S_g=[[0, 2], [1, 4], [3, 1], [4, 0]]) followed by reduce_weights; bilayer layout planar.grid_coordinates (A and B qubits of cell (i,j) at site (i,j) on two layers). Supports found by mutation search over 4+4 monomials in a 5x5 box. Tile-code family of arXiv:2504.09171; this support pair and lattice size are not taken from that paper.
provenance.notes: Equivalence checked: the gate's dedup step found no exact duplicate and no WL-equivalent board entry (checked, not equivalent). Distance is an RIS upper bound held flat over ~7.2M trials, pair depth 64, seeds 101/102/201.
